Little Planet — Pocket Adventure

Explore one tiny planet. Seven worlds, seven small moments — 7 Small Wonders.

  • Trail objectives: follow the checklist in the top-right corner. Finish each objective to reveal the next.
  • Fernwood: tend the eternal flame 3×.
  • Clover Fields: water and harvest the rows.
  • Sunstone Oasis: wake the oasis spring.
  • Shell Cove: ring the dune bell.
  • Tideglass Reef: light the lighthouse (you can swim!).
  • Ember Heights: scan the volcano — hold still.
  • Northlight: wake the aurora at the stones.
  • Gather: your axe is always in hand — chop any pine, palm, or orchard tree, split the fallen trunk, mine basalt, pick berries, shear sheep (E). Nodes regrow.
  • Move: WASD, arrow keys, or click anywhere on the planet to walk there.
  • Survive: sprinting burns energy — eat food (F), rest by standing still, beware the arctic cold.
  • Live: hunger, warmth and morale drain daily — cook meals (campfire), sew clothes, sleep in a bed. Press H for the homestead board: build hut → farmhouse, dig a well, plant plots, raise animals.
  • Family: befriend Lena or Marina with gifts, craft a sunstone ring, marry, raise kids — every mouth adds upkeep. Hire hands, survive droughts, floods, tornadoes and wolf packs, then retire into your heir.
  • Bears: adult polar bears attack up close — swing your axe (E) to fight back. Pick 🌿 remedy from glowing bushes, press R to heal fast. Save anytime from the pause menu (Esc → Save Game); death returns you to your last save.
